senses.gloss:
उभय, अस्, ई, अम्, (pl. m. f. n. ए, आस्, आनि, only
used in sing. and pl., but by some authorities also in
dual), both.
—उभय-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, possessed
of both qualities.
—उभयङ्-कर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
effecting or accomplishing both.
—उभय-चर,
अस्, आ, अम्, ‘moving in or on both,’ living in water
and on land or in the air, amphibious.
—उभय-
द्युस्, ind., Ved. on both days, on two subsequent days;
the day past and to come.
—उभय-भाग-हर,
अस्, आ, अम्, applicable to two purposes, taking two
shares or parts; (अम्), n. a medicine that acts in two
ways, as an emetic and a purge.
—उभय-वत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, Ved. furnished with or containing both.
—उभय-विद्या, f. the twofold science, i. e. religious
knowledge and acquaintance with worldly affairs.
—उभय-विध, अस्, आ, अम्, appearing under two
forms.
—उभय-विपुला, f., N. of a metre.
—उभ-
य-वेतन, अस्, आ, अम्, serving two masters, receiving
wages from both.
—उभय-व्यञ्जन, अस्, आ, अम्,
having the marks of both sexes.
—उभय-सम्भव,
अस्, m. a dilemma.
—उभयात्मक (˚य-आत्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, belonging to both.
—उभयानुमत (˚य-अन्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, agreed to or accepted mutually or on both
sides.
—उभयार्थम् (˚य-अर्˚), ind. for a double
object, as for prosperity on earth and happiness in
heaven.

उभया, ind., Ved. in both ways.
—उभया-दत्,
अन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having teeth on both sides.
—उभया-
विन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. being on both sides, partaking of
both.
—उभया-हस्ति, ind., Ved. as much as may be
grasped with both hands.
—उभया-हस्त्य, अस्, आ,
अम्, Ved. filling both hands.

उभयतस्, ind. from both sides, on both sides, to
both sides; in both cases.
—उभयतः-क्ष्णुत्, त्, त्, त्,
Ved. two-edged.
—उभयतो-दत्, अन्, अती, अत्, having
a double row of teeth (man, animal, &c.).
—उभयतो-
मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, looking either way, two-faced.
—उभयतो-ह्रस्व, अस्, आ, अम्, having a short
vowel on both sides, (an accented vowel) produced
by two short vowels.

उभयत्र, ind. in both places, on both sides; in
both cases, both times.
—उभयत्रोदात्त (˚र-उद्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, having an Udātta accent on both sides;
resulting from the blending of two Udātta accents.
उभयथा, ind. in both ways; in both cases.
उभयीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to both.

उभये-द्युस्, ind. on both days, on two subse-
quent days.
